fact: On 3 May 2025 the Tripoli security director, meeting the heads of investigation of the directorate's police stations and traffic sections, told them to supervise the staff who open reports (mahadir) and to attend to the running of the digital system (al-manzuma al-raqmiyya) as a principal source for the database, which places work on a digital system with station investigation staff eight months before the 31 December 2025 launch; the report does not say whether the system is networked or whether paper is kept alongside.
title: مدير أمن طرابلس يحث رؤساء التحقيق في مراكز الشرطة على ضرورة الالتزام بالإجراءات القانونية السليمة
